definitions.gloss: well-connected, having a wide circle of acquaintances
definitions.explanation: Describes someone who knows many people in various fields or circles and has an extensive network.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{業界|ぎょうかい}で{顔|かお}が{広|ひろ}い。
{顔|かお}が{広|ひろ}い{人|ひと}に{紹介|しょうかい}してもらった。
examples.english: I was introduced by someone with many connections.

examples.japanese: {政治家|せいじか}は{顔|かお}が{広|ひろ}くないと{務|つと}まらない。
examples.english: You can't serve as a politician without being well-connected.

notes:
STRUCTURE: {顔|かお} (face) + が + {広|ひろ}い (wide). Literally 'one's face is wide' - meaning one's face is known widely.

RELATED EXPRESSIONS:
- {顔|かお}が{利|き}く (to have influence, pull) - using connections
- {人脈|じんみゃく}が{広|ひろ}い (to have a wide network) - more formal
- {知|し}り{合|あ}いが{多|おお}い (to have many acquaintances) - simpler expression

NUANCE: Implies not just knowing many people casually, but having meaningful connections that can be useful in business or social situations.

CULTURAL NOTE: In Japanese society, personal connections ({人脈|じんみゃく}) are highly valued for getting things done. Being {顔|かお}が{広|ひろ}い is seen as a valuable social asset.
